parameters.description:
The app identifier should be your app's URL and is used as the primary identifier for rankings.
This is used to track API usage per application.
parameters.name: HTTP-Referer

parameters.description: The app display name allows you to customize how your app appears in OpenRouter's dashboard.
parameters.name: X-OpenRouter-Title

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of app categories (e.g. "cli-agent,cloud-agent"). Used for marketplace rankings.
parameters.name: X-OpenRouter-Categories

creator_user_id.description: Optional user ID of the key creator. Only meaningful for organization-owned keys where a specific member is creating the key.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the API key should expire. Must be UTC, other timezones will be rejected

include_byok_in_limit.description: Whether to include BYOK usage in the limit

limit.description: Optional spending limit for the API key in USD

limit_reset.description: Type of limit reset for the API key (daily, weekly, monthly, or null for no reset). Resets happen automatically at midnight UTC, and weeks are Monday through Sunday.

name.description: Name for the new API key

workspace_id.description: The workspace to create the API key in. Defaults to the default workspace if not provided.

byok_usage.description: Total external BYOK usage (in USD) for the API key

byok_usage_daily.description: External BYOK usage (in USD) for the current UTC day

byok_usage_monthly.description: External BYOK usage (in USD) for current UTC month

byok_usage_weekly.description: External BYOK usage (in USD) for the current UTC week (Monday-Sunday)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the API key was created

creator_user_id.description: The user ID of the key creator. For organization-owned keys, this is the member who created the key. For individual users, this is the user's own ID.

disabled.description: Whether the API key is disabled

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the API key expires, or null if no expiration

hash.description: Unique hash identifier for the API key

include_byok_in_limit.description: Whether to include external BYOK usage in the credit limit

label.description: Human-readable label for the API key

limit.description: Spending limit for the API key in USD

limit_reset.description: Type of limit reset for the API key

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the API key was last updated

usage.description: Total OpenRouter credit usage (in USD) for the API key

usage_daily.description: OpenRouter credit usage (in USD) for the current UTC day

usage_monthly.description: OpenRouter credit usage (in USD) for the current UTC month

usage_weekly.description: OpenRouter credit usage (in USD) for the current UTC week (Monday-Sunday)

workspace_id.description: The workspace ID this API key belongs to.

key.description: The actual API key string (only shown once)
